FUN_a008a568.notes: Digits are converted to font codes (character - 47).
FUN_a008a568.evidence: callers include the factory menu osd_factory_increase_value; sprintf '%1d' / '%3d'
FUN_a008a568.plain: Shows a number in the factory service menu.

FUN_a008a778.name: osd_draw_factory_field_value
FUN_a008a778.brief: Draw the stored value 0xA802AFBA in factory menu field 0x16.
FUN_a008a778.plain: Shows a value in the factory service menu.

FUN_a008a794.name: osd_factory_cursor_up
FUN_a008a794.brief: Move the factory menu highlight to the previous item (wraps)
FUN_a008a794.notes: Item index 0xA802AFBD runs 1..0x1A and wraps to 0x1A below 0x0D; on a colour row or item 0x14 it also sets and applies the colour temperature.
FUN_a008a794.evidence: un-highlights / highlights the layout entries (attributes 0x790 / 0x90); twin of osd_factory_cursor_down
FUN_a008a794.plain: Moves the selection up in the factory service menu.

FUN_a008a878.name: osd_factory_cursor_down
FUN_a008a878.brief: Move the factory menu highlight to the next item (wraps)
FUN_a008a878.notes: Item index 0xA802AFBD steps up and wraps to 0x0D after 0x1A; on a colour row or item 0x14 it also sets and applies the colour temperature.
FUN_a008a878.evidence: twin of osd_factory_cursor_up with an increment
FUN_a008a878.plain: Moves the selection down in the factory service menu.

FUN_a008a95c.name: osd_factory_select_item
FUN_a008a95c.brief: Move the factory menu highlight to the item's value and toggle item 0x14's switch.
FUN_a008a95c.notes: Item 0x14 copies its bit into settings word +0x1D4 bit 6.
FUN_a008a95c.evidence: code: highlight of the value cells; caller osd_factory_leave_item_edit (key handler)
FUN_a008a95c.plain: Enters the value of the chosen item in the factory service menu.

FUN_a008abe0.name: osd_draw_panel_ctrl_value
FUN_a008abe0.brief: Draw the panel controller's register value in factory menu field 0x15.
FUN_a008abe0.evidence: docs/MAP.md: panel controller at I2C address 0x60
FUN_a008abe0.plain: Shows a panel controller reading in the factory service menu.

FUN_a008ac00.name: osd_draw_factory_sensing_test
FUN_a008ac00.brief: Draw ON or OFF for the factory menu item "Sensing Test" (saved setting 0x10)
FUN_a008ac00.notes: Nothing calls it directly; the same drawing is inlined in osd_draw_factory_menu.
FUN_a008ac00.evidence: draws ROM 'OFF'/'ON' at item 23, whose label is 'Sensing Test' in osd_draw_factory_menu
FUN_a008ac00.plain: Shows whether the panel sensing test is switched on in the factory menu.

FUN_a008ac90.name: osd_draw_factory_phy_cts_auto
FUN_a008ac90.brief: Draw ON or OFF for the factory menu item "PHY CTS AUTO" (saved setting 2)
FUN_a008ac90.notes: Nothing calls it directly; the same drawing is inlined in osd_draw_factory_menu.
FUN_a008ac90.evidence: docs/MAP.md: item 24 = PHY CTS AUTO = setting 2; ROM 'OFF'/'ON'
FUN_a008ac90.plain: Shows whether the signal compliance test switch is on in the factory menu.

FUN_a008ad20.name: osd_factory_show_pressed_key
FUN_a008ad20.brief: Show the number of the front key just pressed and log it for the factory key test.
FUN_a008ad20.notes: Saves the key-test record (EEPROM 0x2E0, 0x1C bytes) after each new key; value 0x3F = all six keys seen.
FUN_a008ad20.evidence: ROM texts 'Key', 'Pressed', '%1d'; ORs the key bit into the record saved by SYSAPI_WriteEEPROM
FUN_a008ad20.plain: Part of the factory button test: shows which button was pressed and remembers it.

FUN_a008b2bc.name: osd_factory_show_keys_passed
FUN_a008b2bc.brief: Show "All Key Pass" in the factory key test.
FUN_a008b2bc.evidence: draws ROM texts 'All', 'Key', 'Pass' on one row
FUN_a008b2bc.plain: Tells the factory worker that every front button works.

FUN_a008b330.name: osd_close_factory_info_page
FUN_a008b330.brief: Close the menu when a factory information page (state 0x113 or 0x114) is open.
FUN_a008b330.returns: param_1, or the result of osd_close_menu
FUN_a008b330.evidence: tests osd_get_menu_state for 0x113 (set after osd_draw_factory_info_page) / 0x114, calls osd_close_menu

FUN_a008b380.name: osd_draw_factory_ssc_freq
FUN_a008b380.brief: Draw the selected spread-spectrum clock frequency (kHz/MHz) in the factory menu.
FUN_a008b380.notes: Byte 0xA802AFB8 (0..7) picks 23.4 kHz .. 3 MHz from a local table.
FUN_a008b380.plain: Shows the anti-interference clock setting in the factory menu.

FUN_a008b58c.name: osd_calc_factory_ssc_ratio
FUN_a008b58c.brief: Return the spread-spectrum ratio value in hundredths of a percent from the two SSC bytes.
FUN_a008b58c.notes: Unused; osd_draw_factory_ssc_ratio computes the same value inline.
FUN_a008b58c.evidence: same formula as osd_draw_factory_ssc_ratio; nothing refers to it
FUN_a008b58c.plain: Works out the anti-interference clock strength shown in the factory menu.

FUN_a008b5e0.name: osd_draw_factory_ssc_ratio
FUN_a008b5e0.brief: Draw the spread-spectrum ratio (x.xx %) and its register value in the factory menu.
FUN_a008b5e0.notes: Inputs are the bytes 0xA802AFB8 (frequency step) and 0xA802AFB9 (ratio step).
FUN_a008b5e0.plain: Shows the anti-interference clock strength in the factory menu.

FUN_a008b83c.name: osd_factory_decrease_value
FUN_a008b83c.brief: Lower or toggle the value of the selected factory menu item and redraw it.
FUN_a008b83c.notes: 25 items (1..17 and 19..26; Reset, item 18, has none): colour gains, brightness, SSC, factory marker, Burn In, CTS switches; some changes are saved at once.
FUN_a008b83c.evidence: factory menu '-' key handler (header); twin of osd_factory_increase_value
FUN_a008b83c.plain: Handles the minus button in the factory service menu.

FUN_a008c25c.name: osd_factory_increase_value
FUN_a008c25c.brief: Raise or toggle the value of the selected factory menu item and redraw it.
FUN_a008c25c.notes: Item 24 toggles PHY CTS AUTO, which changes the panel-mode thresholds (docs/MAP.md).
FUN_a008c25c.plain: Handles the plus button in the factory service menu.

FUN_a008cc28.name: osd_draw_number_2digits
FUN_a008cc28.brief: Draw a number as two digits at a menu text position.
FUN_a008cc28.notes: Unused copy; the menus inline this code.
FUN_a008cc28.plain: Writes a two-digit number on the menu.

FUN_a008ccc0.name: osd_draw_on_time_minutes
FUN_a008ccc0.brief: Draw the two-digit minutes part of the monitor on-time counter.
FUN_a008ccc0.notes: Top byte of the word 0xA802E1A8 in the saved settings; inlined in the info pages.
FUN_a008ccc0.evidence: drawn next to 'Monitor On Time' with the 5-digit field (osd_draw_factory_info_page)
FUN_a008ccc0.plain: Shows the minutes of the monitor's total running time.

FUN_a008cd58.name: osd_draw_number_5digits
FUN_a008cd58.brief: Draw a number as five digits at a menu text position.
FUN_a008cd58.notes: Unused copy; the menus inline this code.
FUN_a008cd58.plain: Writes a five-digit number on the menu.

FUN_a008cdf0.name: osd_draw_on_time_hours
FUN_a008cdf0.brief: Draw the five-digit hours part of the monitor on-time counter.
FUN_a008cdf0.notes: Draws the word 0xA802E1A8 shifted right by 8, without a mask, so the minutes byte lands above the hours; nothing calls it (the info pages have their own copy).
FUN_a008cdf0.evidence: drawn on the 'Monitor On Time' row (osd_draw_factory_info_page, osd_draw_factory_menu)
FUN_a008cdf0.plain: Shows the hours of the monitor's total running time.

FUN_a008ce90.name: osd_draw_factory_info_page
FUN_a008ce90.brief: Draw the factory information page: model, firmware version, serial, panel, on-time.
FUN_a008ce90.evidence: ROM texts 'MSI MPG 321URX', 'FW VER:', 'FW.021 20260112', 'SN:', 'Panel:', 'Monitor On Time'
FUN_a008ce90.plain: Shows the monitor's model, firmware version, serial number and running time.

FUN_a008d2e0.name: osd_open_factory_info_page
FUN_a008d2e0.brief: Draw the factory information page and set the menu state to 0x113.

FUN_a008d2f8.name: osd_draw_factory_menu
FUN_a008d2f8.brief: Draw the whole factory service menu with all item labels and values.
FUN_a008d2f8.evidence: ROM texts 'Burn In', 'Reset', 'SSC', 'PHY CTS AUTO', 'Panel ERR Count', ... and the item layout table
FUN_a008d2f8.plain: Shows the hidden factory service menu.

FUN_a008e270.name: osd_factory_activate_item
FUN_a008e270.brief: Run the selected factory menu item: Reset, Exit or start editing its value.
FUN_a008e270.notes: Item 0x12 restores the default settings; item 0x1C closes the menu.
FUN_a008e270.evidence: item 0x12 ('Reset') reloads defaults, 0x1C closes the menu; reached with menu state 0x112
FUN_a008e270.plain: Handles the OK button in the factory service menu.

FUN_a008e520.name: osd_draw_factory_aux0_hours
FUN_a008e520.brief: Draw factory record halfword +0x12 (the hours count) as five digits.
FUN_a008e520.evidence: factory record +0x12, which sys_run_app_timer_task counts as hours
FUN_a008e520.plain: Shows the hours count of the factory record as five digits.

FUN_a008e5b8.name: osd_draw_factory_aux0_minutes
FUN_a008e5b8.brief: Draw factory record byte +0x11 (the minutes count) as two digits.
FUN_a008e5b8.evidence: sprintf "%2ld" of factory record +0x11, which sys_run_app_timer_task counts as minutes
FUN_a008e5b8.plain: Shows the minutes count of the factory record as two digits.

FUN_a008e650.name: sys_read_startup_key
FUN_a008e650.brief: Read the front keys at start-up, log them for the key test and set the start-up key option.
FUN_a008e650.notes: When armed by bit 11 of 0xA802CFF4, key code 2 sets bit 14 of the settings word, any other clears it.
FUN_a008e650.evidence: called once by App_CoolInitialize; same key-test logging as sys_scan_keys_post_event
FUN_a008e650.plain: Checks which button is held while the monitor starts.

FUN_a008e7a8.name: sys_poll_events_stub
FUN_a008e7a8.notes: Called by the event pump with the other event sources.

FUN_a008e7b0.name: sys_scan_keys_post_event
FUN_a008e7b0.brief: Read the front keys, apply repeat, long-press and block rules, and post the key event.
FUN_a008e7b0.notes: Key codes 0x40..0x4E from ROM table 0x10051F; 0x4F = none; key 0x40 is dropped within 1 s of the time stamp 0xA802D00E.
FUN_a008e7b0.evidence: posts 0x40-type key events via sys_post_app_event; timing from the key timing setters
FUN_a008e7b0.plain: Turns button presses into commands for the monitor.

FUN_a008ec48.name: sys_set_key_repeat
FUN_a008ec48.brief: Turn auto-repeat on or off for one key, or for all keys with id 0xFF.
FUN_a008ec48.evidence: mode 1 in sys_scan_keys_post_event: fires again after the delay, then every interval
FUN_a008ec48.plain: Decides whether holding a button repeats it.

FUN_a008ed00.name: sys_set_key_long_press
FUN_a008ed00.brief: Make one key (or all with 0xFF) act only after being held for the long-press time.
FUN_a008ed00.evidence: mode 2 in sys_scan_keys_post_event: one event after the hold time, none on a short press
FUN_a008ed00.plain: Makes a button react only to a long press.

FUN_a008edb8.name: sys_set_key_long_press_alt
FUN_a008edb8.brief: Give one key a second event code that it sends when held long.
FUN_a008edb8.notes: Mask 0xA802AFD8, codes 0xA802AFC8[]; a short press still sends the key's own code on release.
FUN_a008edb8.plain: Lets one button do two things: short press and long press.

FUN_a008ee6c.name: sys_set_key_blocked
FUN_a008ee6c.brief: Block or unblock one key, or all keys with id 0xFF.
FUN_a008ee6c.notes: Mask 0xA802AFC0; the logo phase blocks all keys except 0x40.
FUN_a008ee6c.evidence: mode 4 in sys_scan_keys_post_event drops the key; logo code blocks 0xFF then frees 0x40
FUN_a008ee6c.plain: Stops buttons from working, for example while the logo is shown.

FUN_a008ef24.name: sys_set_key_repeat_delay
FUN_a008ef24.brief: Set the hold time before a repeating key repeats for the first time.
FUN_a008ef24.evidence: used as the first wait of key mode 1 in sys_scan_keys_post_event; set by App_Initialize
FUN_a008ef24.plain: Sets how long a button must be held before it starts repeating.

FUN_a008ef30.name: sys_set_key_repeat_interval
FUN_a008ef30.brief: Set the time between repeats of a held key.
FUN_a008ef30.evidence: used as the repeat wait of key mode 1 in sys_scan_keys_post_event; set by App_Initialize
FUN_a008ef30.plain: Sets how fast a held button repeats.

FUN_a008ef3c.name: sys_set_key_long_press_time
FUN_a008ef3c.brief: Set the hold time that counts as a long key press.
FUN_a008ef3c.evidence: used by key modes 2 and 3 in sys_scan_keys_post_event; set by App_Initialize
FUN_a008ef3c.plain: Sets how long a button must be held for a long press.

FUN_a008ef48.name: ShowLogo
FUN_a008ef48.brief: Draw the MSI power-on logo and switch the panel on.
FUN_a008ef48.notes: Waits without a time limit until the panel reports on, keeping the 8051 alive signal going.
FUN_a008ef48.plain: Shows the MSI logo when the monitor is switched on.

FUN_a008f354.name: sys_end_logo_restore_picture
FUN_a008f354.brief: Close the logo screen and re-apply the picture settings and layout.
FUN_a008f354.notes: Re-applies PIP mode only when bit 12 of the status halfword 0xA802CFF8 is clear.
FUN_a008f354.evidence: called by sys_release_logo_hold and the timer task; calls osd_close_menu, picture setters, UserSetPIPMode
FUN_a008f354.plain: Ends the start-up logo and brings back the normal picture settings.

FUN_a0090f30.name: input_used_ports_in_state4
FUN_a0090f30.brief: Return 1 when every used input port is in application state 4.
FUN_a0090f30.notes: State 4 also covers raw states 3, 5 and above 12; reached through a table.
FUN_a0090f30.plain: Checks that all active inputs are in one particular state.

FUN_a0090f94.name: osd_set_seconds_countdown
FUN_a0090f94.notes: Halfword 0xA802AFF2, counted down every 1000 ms by the menu timer handler.
FUN_a0090f94.evidence: counted down each second in osd_run_periodic_task, which acts when it reaches 0

FUN_a0093f90.name: osd_move_pip_window_up

FUN_a0094108.name: osd_move_pip_window_down

FUN_a009f184.name: osd_check_panel_protect_prompt

FUN_a009f184.evidence: sets menu state 0x10A whose handlers draw texts 0x190184 'Execute|Cancel|Later|More Info'; called by osd_run_periodic_task

FUN_a009f42c.name: osd_run_periodic_task

FUN_a009f42c.plain: Keeps on-screen messages, the alarm clock and reminders running on time.

FUN_a00a012c.name: osd_run_task_post_redraw_event
FUN_a00a012c.brief: Run the menu timers, then post the first pending menu redraw request as an event.
FUN_a00a012c.notes: Posts 0x80..0x83 (0x84 none) from the request bits of byte 0xA802B08E.
FUN_a00a012c.evidence: calls osd_run_periodic_task then sys_post_app_event; called by sys_pump_app_events
FUN_a00a012c.plain: Lets the menu redraw itself after a change.

FUN_a00cbe9c.name: uart_cmd_check_data_block

FUN_a00cbe9c.evidence: set row 0x91; sum of bytes 6..17 against byte 18
FUN_a00cbe9c.plain: Checks a block of data sent by the PC tool.

FUN_a00cc140.name: uart_cmd_write_factory_record

FUN_a00cc140.plain: Lets MSI's PC tool write the monitor's factory data.
